bagPolicy.summary: The venue does not set a bag size limit. All bags, purses, coats and hats are subject to search, and bags can be checked for $5 cash.
prohibited: Packages whose contents are not displayed
bagPolicy.note: Coat check runs on cold nights, and bags can be checked as separate items for $5 each, cash only. Food is allowed for certain medical conditions. Event pages may override this list.

parking.summary: The venue-specific FAQ says accessible vehicle parking can be arranged in advance by emailing the venue; it does not list a general concert parking lot or rate.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue-specific event FAQ does not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food is prohibited except for certain medical needs. Guests may bring one factory-sealed water bottle; other outside beverages are prohibited.
prohibited: Outside food except for medical needs
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Email mail@knockdowncenter.com with the event and accommodation needs before the show, arrive early, and alert box-office staff or security. Accessible vehicle parking may be arranged in advance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue-specific FAQ says no re-entry for ticketed events unless the individual event calendar says otherwise.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The DICE ticketing FAQ says a mobile QR code can be activated starting two hours before the event; it does not give a physical will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Door times are listed on individual event pages; guests must show valid government-issued photo ID and may be searched on arrival.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
